1) editlog 写入慢直接影响所有元数据操作，先用 iostat -x 1: 1) Slow editlog writes directly affect every metadata operation — first use iostat -x 1 to check whether the disk holding the FE metadata directory is saturated; 2) Confirm the FE metadata directory does not share a disk with data; a dedicated SSD is recommended; 3) Check network latency between FEs — multi-replica editlog must be synchronised; 4) Look for a burst of DDL or load jobs submitted at the same time.
1) 在 FE 上用 SHOW PROCESSLIST 看当前慢查询，必要时 K: 1) On the FE run SHOW PROCESSLIST to see current slow queries and KILL <id> to stop the bleeding if needed; 2) Sort fe.audit.log by QueryTime to find the top slow SQL; 3) Use EXPLAIN to check whether partition pruning and indexes are used, and whether a large-table JOIN is missing colocate; 4) Combine with BE CPU and the scanner thread pool queue to tell FE planning from BE execution as the bottleneck.
1) 在该 BE 节点用 netstat -s | grep -i error: 1) On that BE node run netstat -s | grep -i error to see the specific error types; 2) Run ethtool -S <nic> to check for physical-layer errors; 3) Check network quality between BEs and from FE to BE (mtr); 4) Confirm the link is not saturated — Doris query fragment transfer is bandwidth intensive.
1) 查 fe.audit.log 找扫描行数最大的 SQL，优先加分区裁剪、前: 1) Check fe.audit.log for the SQL scanning the most rows and reduce the scan with partition pruning, prefix indexes or materialized views; 2) Run SHOW PROC '/backends' to check whether BE load is unbalanced; 3) Raise doris_scanner_thread_pool_thread_num in be.conf and restart, but only if CPU has headroom; 4) If disk IO is saturated, consider SSDs or adding BE nodes.
1) 查 fe.audit.log 过滤 State=ERR 的记录，看具体报错: 1) Filter fe.audit.log for State=ERR records and read the specific error; 2) Separate syntax/permission errors (user-side) from resource/timeout errors (server-side); 3) For resource errors, combine BE CPU, memory and scan queue to find the bottleneck; 4) If it lines up with a recent change (upgrade, schema modification), roll back to verify.
1) 查 fe.log 搜 edit log clean 相关报错；2) 确认元: 1) Search fe.log for edit log clean errors; 2) Confirm free space and permissions on the metadata directory; 3) Check whether an FE node has fallen far behind and is preventing log trimming — use SHOW FRONTENDS to see node states; 4) If a lagging node cannot recover, consider removing and re-adding it.
1) 查 fe.log 搜 image clean 相关报错，确认是权限还是磁盘: 1) Search fe.log for image clean errors and determine whether it is permissions or disk; 2) Use df -h and ls -lh <meta_dir>/image to check directory size and free space; 3) For permissions, fix the directory owner; for a full disk, clean other files first; 4) Longer term, give the FE metadata directory enough dedicated space.
1) 查 fe.log 搜 image write 相关报错，常见为磁盘空间不足: 1) Search fe.log for image write errors — usually insufficient disk space or memory; 2) Use df -h for the metadata directory and jstat to check whether the FE heap is tight; 3) For low memory, raise the FE -Xmx; for low disk, clean up or expand; 4) After fixing, confirm a new image file appears under <meta_dir>/image — this verification step is mandatory.
1) 查 fe.log 搜 reject 相关日志确认拒绝原因；2) 最常见是导: 1) Search fe.log for reject-related entries to confirm the reason; 2) The most common cause is load concurrency exceeding the FE transaction limit (max_running_txn_num_per_db) — use SHOW PROC '/transactions' for the current count; 3) As an emergency measure raise max_running_txn_num_per_db, but the real fix is lower load concurrency with larger batches; 4) Confirm the loader has retry logic and rerun the rejected jobs.
1) 查 fe.log 搜索 transaction failed 找到失败原因: 1) Search fe.log for 'transaction failed' to find the reason; 2) Common causes are insufficient tablet replicas, an unavailable BE, or timeouts — use SHOW PROC '/statistic' for unhealthy replicas; 3) Confirm the loader has retry logic and add it if not; 4) After fixing the BE or replica problem, rerun the failed load jobs.
1) 查 fe.log 里事务相关的耗时日志，确认是 publish 阶段还是执: 1) Check the transaction timing entries in fe.log to tell whether publish or execution is slow; 2) Slow publish usually means slow BE responses or unhealthy tablet replicas — use SHOW PROC '/statistic' for the unhealthy replica count; 3) Check whether load concurrency is too high and lower it or use larger batches; 4) Check BE disk IO and compaction pressure.
1) 检查 BE 之间的网络带宽与延迟（iperf3、mtr）；2) 确认是否有: 1) Check bandwidth and latency between BEs (iperf3, mtr); 2) Check whether a large result set query is doing heavy shuffle, and use EXPLAIN to see whether a colocate join can reduce the transfer; 3) Raise send_batch_thread_pool_thread_num in be.conf; 4) Confirm the NIC is not saturated and upgrade to 10GbE if needed.
1) 用 SHOW PROC '/backends' 确认各 BE 的负载是否均: 1) Run SHOW PROC '/backends' to check whether BE load is balanced; 2) Lower load job concurrency or increase batch size to reduce tiny loads; 3) Raise doris_max_pending_batch_size and the related thread pool parameters in be.conf and restart the BE; 4) Check whether disk IO is saturated — the final bottleneck for loading is usually the disk.
1) 用 SHOW PROCESSLIST 找当前正在执行的大查询，必要时 KI: 1) Run SHOW PROCESSLIST to find large running queries and KILL them to stop the bleeding if needed; 2) Use fe.audit.log to find the SQL scanning the most rows and add partition pruning or materialized views; 3) Check whether compaction is consuming CPU (search the BE log for compaction); 4) If query volume genuinely grew, add BE nodes.
1) 用 SHOW TRANSACTION WHERE STATUS='ABOR: 1) Run SHOW TRANSACTION WHERE STATUS='ABORTED' to see the specific transactions and reasons; 2) aborted is usually a timeout or insufficient replicas; unknown needs the most attention — it means the FE cannot confirm the final state; 3) Fix the underlying problem (BE availability, replica health) and reload; 4) For unknown transactions, verify with the business side whether data is duplicated or missing.
1) 用 jstat -gcutil \u003cpid\u003e 1000: 1) Run jstat -gcutil <pid> 1000 to watch GC frequency and old generation usage; 2) High FE memory usually comes from too much metadata (an explosion of tables/partitions/tablets) — use SHOW PROC '/statistic' to see the scale; 3) Raise the FE JAVA_OPTS -Xmx and restart (roll the restart to avoid impact); 4) For the root cause, reduce partition counts and drop unused tables — Doris keeps all metadata in memory, so scale control is an ongoing discipline.
BE 发送数据包的线程池积压，查询结果或导入数据在节点间传输受阻，会拖慢整体响应: The BE send thread pool is backed up: query results or load data are blocked in transit between nodes, slowing overall responses.
BE 的 OlapScanner 扫描线程池出现排队，说明扫描任务已超出处理能力: The BE OlapScanner thread pool is queueing, which means scan tasks exceed processing capacity and query latency will rise.
BE 的 batch 写入线程池队列积压超过 20，导入任务开始排队，写入延迟会: The BE batch write thread pool queue exceeds 20: load jobs are queueing and write latency will rise noticeably.
BE 节点 CPU 使用率超过 70%，查询执行会开始排队，响应时间上升。: BE node CPU utilization is above 70%: query execution will start queueing and response times will rise.
BE 节点出现 TCP 接收错误，网络链路存在问题，会导致查询分片传输失败与重试: The BE node is seeing TCP receive errors: there is a network link problem causing query fragment transfer failures and retries.
Doris JVM 堆使用率超过 85%，FE/BE 会频繁 Full GC，元: Doris JVM heap usage is above 85%: FE/BE will full-GC frequently, metadata operations and query planning will stall, and further growth may cause OOM.
Doris_BE 1 分钟新增tcp包接收错误的次数: Doris_BE TCP packet receive errors in the last 1 minute
Doris_BE batch 的线程池队列积压: Doris_BE batch thread pool queue backlog
Doris_FE 日志写入延迟95分位: Doris_FE P95 edit log write latency
Doris_FE 日志写入延迟99分位: Doris_FE P99 edit log write latency
FE 元数据日志 P99 写入延迟超过 2 秒，元数据操作出现严重尾延迟，可能引: FE metadata log P99 write latency exceeds 2 seconds: metadata operations have severe tail latency, which may destabilise FE leader election.
FE 元数据日志（editlog）P95 写入延迟超过 1 秒，所有元数据操作（: FE metadata log (editlog) P95 write latency exceeds 1 second: every metadata operation (table creation, load transactions, partition changes) is slowed down.
FE 每秒错误查询数超过 1，用户提交的查询正在实实在在地失败。: The FE error query rate is above 1 per second: user-submitted queries are genuinely failing.
FE 清理 editlog 失败，元数据日志会持续堆积占用磁盘，且会拖慢 FE: The FE failed to clean editlog: metadata logs will keep accumulating and consuming disk, and will slow down replay at FE startup.
FE 清理元数据镜像文件失败，元数据目录会持续膨胀，最终可能写满磁盘导致 FE: The FE failed to clean metadata image files: the metadata directory will keep growing and may eventually fill the disk and take the FE down.
FE 生成元数据镜像失败。镜像是 FE 重启时的恢复基础，长期失败会导致重启回放: The FE failed to generate a metadata image. The image is the recovery basis at FE restart, so sustained failure makes restart replay extremely long or impossible — this is a high-risk item.
FE 的 P95 查询延迟超过 5 秒，多数用户已经能明显感受到慢。: FE P95 query latency exceeds 5 seconds; most users can already feel the slowdown.
FE 的 P99 查询延迟超过 10 秒，尾部查询已经严重超时，上游可能已在重试: FE P99 query latency exceeds 10 seconds: tail queries are badly timing out and upstream retries may be amplifying the load.
事务 publish 阶段 P95 耗时超过 5 秒，导入任务的可见延迟变长，数: Transaction publish P95 exceeds 5 seconds: load jobs take longer to become visible and freshly written data cannot be queried for a while.
事务 publish 阶段 P99 耗时超过 10 秒，尾部导入任务的数据可见延: Transaction publish P99 exceeds 10 seconds: data visibility delay for tail load jobs is already severe.
事务执行 P95 耗时超过 5 秒，导入吞吐会明显下降。: Transaction execution P95 exceeds 5 seconds and load throughput will drop noticeably.
事务执行 P99 耗时超过 10 秒，尾部导入任务已经严重拖慢。: Transaction execution P99 exceeds 10 seconds: tail load jobs are severely slowed.
存在 aborted 或 unknown 状态的事务，这些事务的数据状态不确定，: There are transactions in aborted or unknown state; their data state is uncertain and may cause missing or duplicated data.
最近 5 分钟出现失败的事务，对应的导入任务没有成功写入，数据缺失。: Transactions failed in the last 5 minutes: the corresponding load jobs did not write successfully and data is missing.
最近 5 分钟有事务被拒绝，对应的导入任务直接失败，数据没有写入。: Transactions were rejected in the last 5 minutes: the corresponding load jobs failed outright and no data was written.
